mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_personal_menu_id AS parentId, menu_code AS menuCode, resource_name AS resourceName, resource_type AS resourceType, route_path AS routePath, icon, sort_no AS sortNo, 1 AS authorized FROM personal_tenant_menu WHERE status = 1 AND valid = 1 AND resource_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY sort_no, id

SELECT m.id, m.parent_tenant_menu_id AS parentId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.resource_name AS resourceName, m.resource_type AS resourceType, m.route_path AS routePath, m.icon, m.sort_no AS sortNo, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN role_menu rm ON rm.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rm.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN tenant_menu granted ON granted.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id AND granted.id = rm.tenant_menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.valid = 1 AND ur.effective_start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (ur.effective_end_time IS NULL OR ur.effective_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND r.status = 1 AND r.valid = 1 AND rm.valid = 1 AND granted.status = 1 AND granted.valid = 1 AND (granted.id = m.id OR (rm.include_descendants = 1 AND LEFT(m.men_path, CHAR_LENGTH(granted.men_path) + 1) = CONCAT(granted.men_path, ';'))) ) AS authorized FROM tenant_menu m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.valid = 1 AND m.resource_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
